tool.name: Read Older Messages
tool.description: Read older conversation history beyond the agent prompt window. `offset` skips that many most recent messages (tail offset), then returns the next `limit` older messages (chronological order).

limit.description: How many messages to return (1-200). Keep this small to reduce tokens.

offset.description: How many most recent messages to skip (tail offset). Example: offset=30 reads messages immediately older than the newest 30.

conversationId.description: Conversation id (optional; defaults to the current CONVERSATION_ID runtime env)

nodes.name: Get Conversation Messages (Starships)
nodes.description: GET /conversations/:conversationId/messages via Starships connector endpoint catalog

nodes.name: Unwrap
nodes.description: Return body.data/body.error where applicable; otherwise return body/resp

nodes.name: Slim
nodes.description: Return a minimal, token-efficient message list
